provenance.what: Relic/World's Edge API civilization_id -> site civ slug. The API uses its OWN id space (roughly alphabetical), NOT the game/replay civ_id space that civ-id-map.json maps. Applying civ-id-map.json to API ids silently shuffles every civ label.
derivedFrom: corpus join: 734,280 player rows / 194,202 matches — replay-parsed civ_id (game space) x crawl civilization_id (API space) joined on (match_id, profile_id), 2026-06-07..2026-06-17; every id below is the dominant pair with >=4.5k confirming rows and <=4 contradicting rows
Relic API getAvailableLeaderboards?title=age2 'races' table fetched 2026-07-02 — publishes id->name directly; agrees with the corpus join on all 53 ranked ids
aoestats historical join (2.34M rows, 2022-08..2026-02) — validates stability inside the current era and dates the earlier id-space shifts
provenance.eraNotes: The API id space RE-SHUFFLES at some patch/DLC boundaries. Confirmed shifts: pre-2023-10 ids are alphabetical over fewer civs (do NOT map with this table); 2025-05..2025-08 had jurchens=53, khitans=54 before an Aug-2025 patch compacted them to 51/52; 58-60 (muisca/mapuche/tupi) appended 2026-02. Matches completed before validFrom MUST NOT be mapped with this table.
provenance.apiNameQuirks: API id 21 is named 'Indians' (pre-rename); maps to hindustanis. Ids 53-54 are absent from the current races table.
